title: guajava turbiniflora
intro: Guajava turbiniflora, commonly known as Turbiniflora Guava, is a plant species in the family Myrtaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions, including digestive issues and inflammation, due to its potential health benefits such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Turbiniflora Guava include anti-ulcerative, anti-diarrheal, and antiseptic effects, which contribute to its use in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of Turbiniflora Guava include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
